description:
ISCA mechanics on all cash paths (web, POS, cashless): the ADR-003 journal plus period closures (Z/daily/monthly/fiscal-year), fiscal archives, audit export. Certification itself out of scope; verify mechanics against the actual NF525 referential (brief flags ISCA as inferred).

**Conditions of Success:**
- Closures compute and seal period totals; sealed periods are provably inalterable
- Fiscal archive export in an auditor-consumable format
- Requirements traceable to the NF525 referential text, gaps explicitly listed

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).
